Then separately retain the already-supported death/victory terminal holds and Retry reset receipts.

blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Produce a closure-ready release candidate with reliable dense-play framing, bounded audible footsteps, and a naturally winnable seven-to-ten-minute five-wave run supporting Lantern-, Gravespade-, and Wandering-Wisps-focused builds while preserving the accepted cemetery, Warden package, authored shell, terminal animation holds, and clean lifecycle behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three independent causes: the camera's occluder-only compositor cannot recover a Warden already outside the viewport safe frame; footstep voice allocation checks for a free player before enforcing movement-owner occupancy and repeatedly plays a 4.9-second mostly silent source; and the candidate has not yet demonstrated a naturally viable 420–600 second victory across the three weapon build identities, despite having the five-wave route and diagnostic terminal branches.

stop_conditions: Do not edit, replace, duplicate, reposition, or extract authored cemetery child meshes or replace the accepted Warden package; solve framing at the camera/wrapper boundary.
Do not repeat camera transform, FOV, or arena-limit tuning as the primary occlusion treatment; the repair must enforce a measurable viewport safe frame.
Do not accept a diagnostic-prepared boss/result branch as proof of the complete-run contract; victory must follow the uninterrupted ordinary five-wave route in 420–600 seconds.
Do not schedule the deferred animation semantic-binding issue or any backlog gap in this iteration.
Stop after the three selected surfaces pass focused self-validation; avoid unrelated HUD, world-decoration, weapon-asset, or accessibility expansion.

strategy.rationale: Separate the three root causes into independent implementation passes. Replace the repeatedly unsuccessful camera transform/compositor-only strategy with camera-owned projected safe-frame containment, repair footstep event ownership at allocation and playback duration, and advance the product with naturally viable build-specialized complete runs rather than another diagnostic victory fixture. Existing accepted presentation and lifecycle mechanisms remain intact.

code: Run the frozen native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks after implementation; require clean import, launch, editor logs, and runtime logs.
Inspect camera bindings and diagnostics to confirm the complete Warden presentation remains bound and no authored cemetery child transform or asset binding changed.
Inspect audio allocation order to confirm owner occupancy is evaluated before free-voice selection, and verify every lifecycle reset clears voice ownership.

Verify wave metadata still declares exactly five ordered waves, the final boss, and the 420–600 second ordinary victory window; verify the catalog remains twelve truthful upgrades with valid icons and projections.
runtime: Tester recaptures the original southeast dense-boundary reproduction first, then samples the other reachable foreground boundaries with shipped-camera screenshots, camera coverage, projected-margin state, ordinary movement, and dash.

Tester captures Effects and Master output for footstep tap, sustained movement, direction change, release, pause/resume, result, and Retry; inspect waveform audibility, source-event duration, semantic ownership, and active_by_owner counts.

Tester completes an uninterrupted ordinary title-to-victory route with physical input, ordinary XP collection and drafts, five natural wave transitions, both Bellkeeper phases, committed result, Credits & Notices, Retry, and replay. Diagnostic setup does not satisfy this cell.

Use deterministic ordinary seeds to exercise Lantern-, Gravespade-, and Wandering-Wisps-focused builds; require normal draft transactions and combat systems to cause every choice, hit, boss defeat, and result transition rather than prepared terminal shortcuts every time? No; the ordinary routes must do so for acceptance. Three consecutive retry/title cycles must show stable actor, pickup, signal,?
visual: Compare shipped-camera boundary and dense-combat frames against the bound visual reference's high-angle readability: the Warden, hostile telegraphs, pickups, and escape lane remain legible without changing the cemetery's authored composition.
Confirm safe-frame correction introduces no camera snap, edge pumping, duplicated Warden render, halo separation, or foreground pop.
Confirm the retained warm-lantern versus cool-moonlight hierarchy, compact edge-weighted HUD, authored shell, and terminal Warden poses remain visually unchanged outside the selected repairs.

done_when: Ordinary and representative dense play at southeast, southwest, northeast, and northwest reachable boundaries keeps the complete Warden silhouette inside positive viewport margins, with nearby dangerous telegraphs and at least one useful escape direction readable.
The camera corrects impending safe-frame loss before the Warden reaches the screen edge, without visible snapping, oscillation, excessive lag, or breaking camera-relative movement and dash framing.
Foreground geometry may still occlude briefly only when the existing isolation treatment activates correctly; the player can never remain outside the viewport where that compositor is ineffective.

Runtime state exposes the current safe-frame status, correction state, projected margins, and occlusion-guard status so Tester can pair the same southeast reproduction with black-box footage and white-box receipts.
tasks.instructions: Repair the regressed gameplay-camera issue using a materially different root-cause strategy. First compare the existing private-layer isolation, foreground fading, and direct camera safe-frame containment against the recorded negative viewport margins; use camera-owned projected safe-frame containment as the primary repair and retain isolation only as a secondary response to true sightline obstruction. Constrain correction to the intact authored arena wrapper, preserve the current high-angle perspective and movement lead, and do not tune imported map children or merely adjust transforms/FOV/arena limits again. Add bounded observability for projected margins and correction state.
tasks.title: Enforce a projected gameplay-camera safe frame

done_when: A single locomotion step produces a short, recognizable footstep transient on Effects and Master without silence or narrowband-only analysis flags.
Tap, sustained movement, direction change, and release never exceed two active movement-owner voices; owner occupancy is enforced before any free voice is returned or stolen.
Stopping movement retires footstep playback promptly, and pause, result, Retry, and return-to-title leave no stale footstep voice or playback tail.

Other accepted semantic owners retain their current priority, bus routing, variation, and lifecycle behavior; boss warnings, player hurt, upgrade selection, weapon reports, death, and victory remain audible during dense play.
tasks.instructions: Make footsteps event-owned at both allocation and playback boundaries. Enforce the movement owner limit before accepting a free voice, then audition the bound source and use a genuinely audible bounded playback window or rebind the semantic to an intact short licensed source if the current recording cannot pass mixed-output inspection. Do not edit an imported source internally or synthesize a replacement tone. Ensure movement release and every run-lifecycle transition retire the footstep owner deterministically, while preserving all unrelated semantic audio and the accepted animation/VFX/lighting presentation.
tasks.title: Bound footstep playback and movement polyphony

done_when: Starting through Play with no validation action traverses all five authored wave IDs in order, includes the composition change and elite encounter, spawns the Bellkeeper naturally, exposes both boss phases, and reaches victory between 420 and 600 seconds.

Natural drafts continue to pause gameplay and present three truthful before-to-after choices; within normal experience gain, each of the Lantern-focused, Gravespade-focused, and Wandering-Wisps-focused routes can establish its identity and remain mechanically viable through the boss.

The victory and failure result pages report elapsed time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt, damage taken, weapon ranks, and selected upgrades from the committed terminal snapshot; Credits & Notices remains reachable and accurate.

Retry and return-to-title reset the ordinary route, build, boss, actors, pickups, audio, pause ownership, and HUD without stale state. Three consecutive ordinary lifecycle cycles return to stable baselines.

The accepted failure death hold and victory hold persist through Result, while Retry resets the Warden to idle; diagnostic preparation remains editor-only and is never counted as ordinary-route completion.
tasks.instructions: Advance the release loop by making all three weapon-centered build routes naturally available and viable across the existing nine-minute five-wave sequence. Replace simple cyclic draft starvation with deterministic, truthful offer composition that preserves meaningful choice while allowing specialization in Warden Lantern, Gravespade, or Wandering Wisps. Tune only data-driven upgrade, weapon, wave, and boss values proven to block an ordinary route; retain five waves, the natural boss transition, the 420–600 second victory window, and existing authoritative damage/result accounting. Preserve the authored title, pause, result, credits, terminal animation holds, and teardown mechanisms while correcting any candidate-owned full-route blocker discovered during focused self-play.
tasks.title: Qualify three natural build routes through the complete run
